main.description: One overlay's socialweb-meshd roster, written by its one orchestrator. Record key: the run (a staging stand-up's name). meshd reads it with one getRecord(DID, computer.socialweb.mesh.roster, run) as --roster or a Node's socialweb.computer/mesh-roster; never listed. Deleted at teardown.

zone.description: The DNS zone every member serves (--dns-zone), e.g. <run>.staging.internal.

name.description: The member's name; <name>.<zone> answers its first cidr's address.

endpoint.description: Its iroh endpoint id, 64 lowercase hex (socialweb-meshd identity).

cidrs.description: The networks routed to it: a VM's overlay /32, a k3s node's podCIDR.

names.description: More names under the zone for the same address: the services it runs. *.<name> is a wildcard (did:key ingress https://<did-label>.<host>).

txt.description: TXT records under the zone, e.g. _atproto.<handle> = did=<did> so a handle under the zone resolves.

name.description: Relative to the zone; <name>.<zone> answers the TXT.
